title: Roaring Bitmap Auth-Difference, Lazy EventProvider & Homeserver Utilities

primary_concerns: Critical (OOM / Starvation): Pre-fetching full conflicted graphs into memory per docs/architecture.md exposes the homeserver caller to Out-Of-Memory collapse, async executor thread starvation on adversarial forks (10^4+ events), and transitive bitmap cache corruption.

High (Missing Guards): Hot-path Tier-1 APIs (auth chain diff, roaring auth_difference, state diff, lazy EventProvider, raw event spans) shipped in production while Tier-2 syntactic validation (src/auth/validate.rs) and DAG health / fork detection (src/dag/fork.rs) remain unimplemented in docs/homeserver_utilities.md.
